## About Me

Nina is a PhD student at Johns Hopkins School of Medicine. Her research uses genomics and transcriptomics methodologies to better understand human brain development and disease, with a focus on psychiatric disorders.

Outside of the lab, Nina has a strong interest in teaching and science communication. She has taught courses in genetics, genomics, and data science to high school and undergraduate students, and she is actively involved in outreach programs that aim to make STEM fields more accessible.
